purpose: Recover only the I-25 optimizer-step-250 residual that was observed and hashed during formal training, then rotated when the terminal checkpoint made save_total_limit=6 retain only six of seven directories. This is incident recovery, not a new checkpoint search or training experiment.

incident.formal_training_result: the Trainer completed 1527/1527 optimizer steps and W&B finished; the outer launcher returned 1 only because checkpoint-250 had already been rotated before its postcondition check
incident.formal_exit_code_interpretation: artifact-postcondition failure after successful training; it must not be rewritten to 0

scientific_equivalence.start_state: clean O6 plus the retained I-23 adapter with create_new_adapter=true; no I-25 checkpoint is loaded, resumed, or used as a warm start
scientific_equivalence.configuration_delta: the recovery YAML is field-identical to the formal YAML except output_dir and run_name
scientific_equivalence.scheduler_rule: num_train_epochs remains 1 and max_steps remains absent, so Trainer computes state.max_steps=1527 and creates the cosine LambdaLR with num_training_steps=1527 and warmup_steps=46
scientific_equivalence.stop_rule: a callback with no pre-step RNG or model side effects sets should_save and should_training_stop only in on_step_end after global_step becomes 250
scientific_equivalence.data_order_proof: the callback requires exactly 1000 compute_loss calls and the originally observed action/retention route counts 278/722 at step 250
scientific_equivalence.hardware_rule: replay only on the same physical H100 UUID used by the formal run
scientific_equivalence.identity_boundary: CUDA kernels are not assumed reproducible merely because the recipe matches; only the recorded adapter/config SHA256 pair establishes successful recovery

prelaunch_requirements: the formal output root and surviving checkpoint hashes still match this incident snapshot
the formal root trainer_state global_step is 1527 and checkpoint-1527 is byte-identical to the root adapter/config
the original formal exit-code file remains 1 and the locked log ends with the exact missing-checkpoint-250 failure
the formal checkpoint-250 destination does not exist
the recovery output directory, recovery runtime log, pid, exit-code, and receipt do not exist

the same physical GPU UUID is at the formal-run platform baseline (approximately 27113 MiB used, 0% utilization, and at least 50000 MiB free); the container-external baseline PID is not treated as a competing replay job
W&B is authenticated and WANDB_MODE is online

acceptance_and_install.install_method: copy to a new same-filesystem temporary directory, rehash, fsync files and directory, then rename atomically only while the destination is absent
acceptance_and_install.original_exit_code_policy: do not alter the original formal exit-code file; downstream Stage-1 preparation must validate the successful recovery exit code and receipt together with the exact formal incident signature

rejection_rules: never install if either recovered hash differs, even if tensor shapes, loss, routes, or local scores appear plausible
never retry from the mismatching recovery output and never use it as a parent
never replace or merge any surviving formal checkpoint during this recovery
never change the scheduler horizon to 250 by setting max_steps=250
never select a checkpoint or run a GPU audit as part of recovery
